sentences.text: Case :- Matters Under Article 227 No. - 3993 of 2025

Petitioner :- Sonia Garg
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Himanshu Bansal,Shivam Yadav

Counsel for Respondent :- Amit Daga,G.A.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to make necessary correction in the prayer clause during the course of the day.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the respondent nos. 2, 3 and 4, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.

This petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India has been filed seeking direction to the court concerned to expedite the trial in FIR No. 0577 of 2019 bearing Criminal Case No. 15954 of 2019 (State Vs. Praful & Ors.) under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC along with 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, Police Station Bhrampuri, District Meerut pending in the Court of Additional Court of Judicial Magistrate no. 7 of District Meerut within a stipulated time or in a time frame.
